answer: on-chain history depth proof is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 119 POA of exposure, so 604 aliases carry 71876 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. One beacon of signal, one lantern of cost, one velvet of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
